error.message: No bridge has a usable route for ETH on Base to ETH on Robinhood Chain at this amount. details.routes says why for each bridge: NO_ROUTE means the bridge does not carry this pair at this size — a larger amount often works, since a very small one cannot cover the bridge's own costs; UPSTREAM_ERROR is worth retrying; NOT_CONFIGURED and INVALID_QUOTE will not change on a retry.
